name: Madras
description: Bands crossing at right angles and letting each other show through, the way a madras check builds its colour.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: @pick(4%, 34%, 62%); width: 100%; height: 32%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.9; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(4%, 34%, 62%); top: 0; width: 32%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.6; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
